email.subject: Evergreen Co's site on mobile
email.body:
Hi Omar,

I checked Evergreen Co Heating & Cooling's website. Two things are likely costing you calls: it isn't set up for mobile, so phone searchers (most HVAC leads) have to pinch and scroll just to find your number, and the homepage title doesn't mention heating/cooling or Harbor Falls, so you're harder to find in local search than you should be.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd change?

Alex
